method: Minimum distance to the actual projected axe triangles for the continuous starter ellipse, compared with the maximum horizontal radius of all occupied packet and supporting-frame vertices. A rigid actor yaw preserves each gear radius. Every triangle interior is a convex combination; the cargo maximum is on a vertex. The .89 s path rotates the weapon with the direction of the radius; radial travel is in [2.36,2.64] metres and the entire axe lies ahead of the actor, so the minimum occurs at radius 2.36. The enhanced orbit is farther out. Ten tiers exhaust the two-way orientation and 5-step yaw cycle. If the two radial bands are disjoint, every intervening phase and yaw is safe.
